name: Euler Finance exploit and full recovery (Mar 13 – Apr 12, 2023)

window_utc.notes: start = exploit contract deployment (block 16817996); trough = depositor mark-to-zero moment after six attack txs drained ~$197M and modules were disabled; end = redemptions opened to users at 02:00 UTC Apr 12. Attacker's final return was Apr 3-4 (the brief's 'Apr 4' endpoint); funds were frozen ~30 days, not ~3 weeks — the ~3 weeks figure matches the attacker-return window (Mar 13 to Apr 3).

speed: Drain: ~20 minutes (six transactions starting 08:50:23 UTC, Mar 13). Freeze: same-day, protocol-wide. Negotiated recovery: 22 days to final return (Apr 3-4). Depositor access restored: 30 days (Apr 12, 02:00 UTC). Contagion propagation: same-day (integrator vaults paused within hours).
summary: Euler Finance, 13.03.2023: flash-loan «donation»-атака (отсутствие health-check в donateToReserves) — $197M выкачано за ~20 минут из аудированного блю-чип lending-протокола; депозиты заморожены; заражение в Angle agEUR ($17.6M), Balancer bb-e ($11.9M), Idle/Yearn. УНИКАЛЬНЫЙ исход: под давлением атакующий вернул ВСЁ к 03-04.04, redemption 12.04 ~100% долларовой стоимости на момент эксплойта. Канонический тест учёта: mark-to-zero 13 марта против mark-to-recovery 12 апреля — паническая продажа замороженных требований на вторичке фиксировала −70%+, терпение вернуло всё. Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: Attacker (gas-funded via Tornado Cash) deploys exploit contract at block 16817996. Six attack transactions follow over ~20 minutes: flash-loan (~$30M DAI from Aave in the DAI leg), deposit, 10x eToken mint-leverage loop, donateToReserves() call (added in eIP-14, July 2022, missing the health/liquidity check every other balance-changing function had) creates bad debt, then self-liquidation at soft-liquidation discount lets a second contract seize collateral at a profit.

~$196.9M drained (largest DeFi hack of 2023 to that point and largest-ever lending-protocol exploit at the time): ~$135.8M stETH/wstETH (rekt.news: ~86k ETH-derivatives, $134.6M), ~$33.85M USDC (~34M), ~$18.5M WBTC (849 WBTC), ~$8.75M DAI (~8.9M). Timestamp approximate (attack txs span ~08:56-09:15 UTC).

Euler disables protocol: EToken module off at block 16818363, DToken at block 16818853 — all deposits/withdrawals frozen (these blocks later became the NAV snapshot basis). EUL token drops >45% intraday (from just above $6 pre-hack; reported multi-day low ~$2.07). Time approximate, date confirmed.

Contagion surfaces same day across 11 protocols (~$37.6M total): Angle ~$17.6M USDC stuck (agEUR undercollateralized; minting/redemption paused), Balancer bb-e-USD pool ~$11.9M (>65% of pool TVL; emergency subDAO pauses pool into recovery mode), Idle Finance ~$5.9M (Best Yield / Yield Tranches paused), Yearn ~$1.38M indirect via Angle/Idle strategies; also Yield Protocol, Inverse Finance, SwissBorg, Opyn, Mean Finance, Sense, Harvest. Time approximate.
Euler sends on-chain ultimatum: return 90% within 24 hours (i.e., keep 10% ≈ $19.7M as bounty) or a $1M reward will be placed on information leading to the attacker's arrest.
Deadline passes; Euler launches the $1M information bounty (the 'doxxing threat'). Attacker begins obfuscation: 1,000 ETH through Tornado Cash.
100 ETH of stolen funds sent to an address linked to the Lazarus/Ronin Bridge exploiter — raising (never-substantiated) North Korea attribution questions; widely read as misdirection.
First return: 3,000 ETH (~$5.4M) sent back to Euler's deployer address.

Attacker signals capitulation on-chain: 'We want to make this easy on all those affected. No intention of keeping what is not ours. Setting up secure communication. Let us come to an agreement.' Private negotiations begin.
Lazarus-attributed actors attempt to phish the Euler exploiter via an on-chain message with a malware link (hacker-vs-hacker sideshow, per Chainalysis/CoinDesk).
Largest tranche returned: 51,000 ETH (~$89M). Between Mar 25-28 cumulative returns reach ~84,951 ETH ($147.8M) plus ~$29.9M DAI (Blockworks tally).
Further 7,737 ETH returned (Cointelegraph: 'over 58,000 ETH' cumulative for Mar 25+27).
On-chain apology signed 'Jacob': 'I don't think what I say will help me in any way but I still want to say it. I f***ed up... I am sorry' — accompanied by further ETH and DAI returns.
Final tranche: ~$31M in three transactions — 10,580 ETH (~$19M) + ~$12M DAI (reported '6:55 pm EST' Apr 3; UTC conversion approximate).

Euler announces all recoverable funds returned; $1M information bounty closed ('because the exploiter did the right thing'). Cumulative recovery: 95,556 ETH + ~43M DAI. ~1,100 ETH irrecoverable (Tornado Cash) + 100 ETH sent to the Ronin-linked address. No bounty was ultimately kept by the attacker.

Redemptions open under 'Plan for Redemption of Euler Funds V2': merkle-proof claims (EulerClaims contract) paying each depositor a pro-rata ETH/DAI/USDC basket against account NAV reconstructed at the module-disable blocks (16818363/16818853). Recovered assets worth ~$223M at claim-time prices vs ~$197M exploited — depositors made whole in exploit-time USD terms. Angle receives its share same day, restoring agEUR overcollateralization; Idle subsequently swaps its basket back to original underlyings and restores 100% to vault users.

EUL.window: 2023-03-12 (pre-hack, 'just above $6') -> multi-day post-hack low; intraday Mar 13 drop reported as >45%; trough of ~$2.07 ('nearly 70%') reported over following days; partial recovery to ~$4.05 (+20% day-move) on Apr 3-4 full-return news — still ~35% below pre-hack

euler_protocol_deposits.window: 2023-03-13 ~09:15 UTC mark-to-zero for drained pools (DAI/wstETH/USDC/WBTC); restored to ~100% of exploit-time USD value at redemption 2023-04-12

stablecoins: agEUR (Angle): became undercollateralized after ~$17.6M USDC of backing was caught in Euler; minting/redemption paused Mar 13; peg pressure until recovered funds received Apr 12, 2023 restored overcollateralization (depeg magnitude not verified from sources consulted — LlamaRisk covered the Curve-pool effect)
DAI: unaffected as an instrument — ~8.9M DAI stolen as an asset; no peg event; attacker actually returned ~43M DAI total (converted portions of loot into DAI)

USDC: unaffected as an instrument — ~34M stolen as an asset; no peg event (note: distinct from the USDC depeg of Mar 10-13, 2023 tied to SVB, which was resolving the same weekend and is a separate scenario)

defi_impact.tvl_and_freeze: Entire Euler v1 protocol disabled on Mar 13 (EToken module at block 16818363, DToken at block 16818853); ALL deposits — including untouched ones — frozen ~30 days until claims opened Apr 12 02:00 UTC. The brief's '~3 weeks' matches the attacker-return window (Mar 13-Apr 3), not the freeze.
defi_impact.rank_at_time: Largest DeFi hack of 2023 at the time and largest-ever hack of a DeFi lending protocol (BlockSec, Chainalysis, Bloomberg framing)
defi_impact.recovery_channel: Off-market: funds returned by the attacker himself, not via liquidations — no forced selling, no oracle stress, no cascading liquidations in the wider market
defi_impact.protocol_aftermath: Euler v1 never re-enabled for new deposits; team rebuilt and launched Euler v2 in 2024 after 31 audits (The Block); Euler branded the episode a '$240M recovery' (value of returned assets including ETH appreciation)

causes.root_cause: donateToReserves() was added to the eToken contract in the eIP-14 upgrade (July 2022) without the account health/liquidity check that every other balance-changing function performed — letting a user donate eToken collateral while keeping dToken debt, deliberately making their own account insolvent.
causes.mechanism: Flash-loan amplification + self-liquidation: per attack tx (six total, one per drained market): flash-borrow (e.g. ~$30M DAI from Aave), deposit into Euler, use mint() to lever ~10x eToken/dToken, donate a large eToken slug to reserves creating bad debt, then a second attacker contract liquidates the first at Euler's soft-liquidation discount (up to ~20%), acquiring collateral cheaply and withdrawing the surplus. Repeated across DAI, wstETH, USDC and WBTC pools.
aggravators: Vulnerable function was live ~8 months and had passed audit review (a whitehat later claimed the donateToReserves addition was itself a fix that introduced the bug — The Block)
Flash loans removed any capital barrier
Soft-liquidation discount design made self-liquidation profitable
No health check meant fail-open rather than fail-closed on the donation path
causes.attribution: Self-identified as 'Jacob' in on-chain/encrypted apologies; claimed to be acting alone; 100 ETH sent to a Lazarus/Ronin-linked address was never substantiated as real DPRK involvement and is widely read as misdirection. No prosecution publicly reported.
causes.classification_note: Not a market event: crypto prices broadly were unaffected; ETH actually appreciated over the window, which is why the recovered ETH-heavy basket exceeded the exploited USD value.

contagion: Angle Protocol: ~$17.6M USDC deposited in Euler lost/frozen — agEUR became undercollateralized; minting and redemption paused; seniority vote prioritized agEUR holders over SLPs/hedging agents; overcollateralization restored after receiving recovered funds Apr 12, 2023

Balancer: Euler Boosted USD (bb-e-USD) pool ~$11.9M affected — >65% of pool TVL; emergency subDAO paused pool into recovery mode; OpCo built withdrawal tooling for non-Euler assets (used e.g. by TempleDAO)

Idle Finance: ~$5.9M across Best Yield vaults and Yield Tranches — all Euler-linked vaults paused Mar 13; after redemption, Idle swapped the recovered ETH/DAI/USDC basket back to original underlyings and restored 100% with no user losses
Yearn Finance: ~$1.38M indirect exposure via Angle and Idle strategies (Yearn stated vaults' bad debt would be covered)

Total: 11 DeFi protocols with locked tokens/losses, cumulative ~$37.6M beyond Euler itself — others included Yield Protocol, Inverse Finance, SwissBorg, Opyn, Mean Finance, Sense and Harvest (Cointelegraph count)
Insurance layer: Nexus Mutual paid claims for the Euler loss event; after users were made whole via redemption, Nexus asked claimants to return payouts (documented in Nexus claims history)
NOT contagion: no stablecoin systemic break (DAI/USDC instruments unaffected), no broad market drawdown, no CeFi counterparty failures

recovery.amounts_returned: 95,556 ETH + ~43M DAI cumulative (tranches: 3,000 ETH Mar 18; 51,000 ETH Mar 25; 7,737 ETH Mar 27; further ETH+DAI with apology Mar 28; final ~$31M = 10,580 ETH + ~$12M DAI Apr 3). ~1,100 ETH irrecoverable via Tornado Cash + 100 ETH to Ronin-linked address.
recovery.recovered_value: ~$223M at Apr 12 claim-time prices (CoinDesk/Cointelegraph) vs ~$196.9M exploited; Euler's own retrospective brands it a '$240M recovery'. Excess over exploit-time value came from ETH appreciation during the freeze.
recovery.bounty_outcome: 10% bounty (~$19.7M) was offered Mar 14 but the attacker ultimately returned everything recoverable and kept nothing; the $1M information bounty was closed Apr 4.
recovery.depositor_outcome: Made whole at exploit-time USD NAV: claims computed from account state reconstructed at module-disable blocks 16818363/16818853, paid as pro-rata ETH/DAI/USDC basket via merkle-proof EulerClaims contract (terms-acceptance token required). Small residue still unclaimed years later (~149 ETH across 1,636 addresses reported, later ~32 ETH — figures from 2025-2026 follow-ups).
recovery.integrator_outcomes: Idle: 100% restored to users after basket swap-back. Angle: overcollateralization restored Apr 12. Nexus Mutual claimants asked to return insurance payouts after being made whole.
recovery.token_and_protocol: EUL partially recovered (~$4.05 after Apr 3-4 news vs >$6 pre-hack); v1 wound down; Euler v2 launched 2024 after 31 audits.

confidence_notes: High confidence: attack date/time (Mar 13, 2023, 08:50:23 UTC deploy, block 16817996), ~$196.9M/$197M total, per-asset split ($135.8M stETH/wstETH, ~$34M USDC, $18.5M WBTC 849 tokens, ~$8.75-8.9M DAI — two independent sources each), Mar 14 ultimatum, $1M info bounty, Mar 20 capitulation message, Mar 28 'Jacob' apology, Apr 3-4 final return, cumulative 95,556 ETH + ~43M DAI, Apr 12 02:00 UTC redemption, ~$223M claim-time value, 11-protocol/$37.6M contagion with Angle $17.6M / Balancer $11.9M / Idle $5.9M / Yearn $1.38M. Known discrepancies (ranges reported, not resolved): (1) EUL drawdown — >45% day-one (Decrypt) vs 'nearly 70% to $2.07' at multi-day trough; from_usd 6.0 is 'just above $6' per BeInCrypto, exact pre-hack print not verified; (2) individual return tranches don't sum cleanly to 95,556 ETH across outlets (Blockworks' 84,951 ETH Mar 25-28 vs itemized 51,000+7,737; final DAI $12M per The Block vs '$10M+' elsewhere) — cumulative totals are the reliable numbers; (3) 'deposits frozen ~3 weeks' in the brief is imprecise: attacker returns spanned 22 days but depositor funds were frozen 30 days (Mar 13-Apr 12); (4) 'wstETH' vs 'stETH' labeling varies by outlet (rekt: '86k ETH derivatives' incl. stETH/wstETH/WETH); (5) '$240M recovery' is Euler's own framing at later prices — $223M at Apr 12 is the contemporaneous figure; (6) NAV restoration: depositors were made whole in exploit-time USD terms but paid in an ETH/DAI/USDC basket, so exact per-user outcomes vs pure USDC depended on conversion timing; agEUR depeg depth and Sherlock/Nexus insurance payout amounts were not verified and are deliberately omitted rather than estimated.

data_availability.on_chain: Complete: attack txs at block 16817996+ (Ethereum mainnet), attacker EOAs and exploit contracts public, all return tranches and on-chain messages traceable via Etherscan; redemption merkle data in github.com/euler-xyz/euler-redemption-scripts (module-disable blocks 16818363/16818853)
data_availability.primary_sources: Euler governance forum (redemption plans), euler.finance blog (War & Peace retrospective), rekt.news, Chainalysis, CoinDesk, Coinbase investigation, and cointelegraph.com were egress-blocked for direct fetch in this environment — content was verified via search-indexed full-text summaries and cross-checked across 4+ independent outlets per headline number
data_availability.price_data: EUL intraday OHLC not directly pulled; drawdown reported as a range from news sources (>45% day-one, ~70% to $2.07 at trough). agEUR depeg magnitude not verified (LlamaRisk archive covers it). Euler pre-hack TVL not verified — left null rather than estimated
data_availability.quality: High for amounts stolen/returned and dates (multiple independent confirmations); medium for exact tranche-by-tranche arithmetic (see confidence_notes)

spa_relevance.aave_v3_40pct: Direct analog: Euler was a blue-chip-adjacent, audited lending protocol — same category of risk as the $40k Aave v3 sleeve. Lesson: an audited money market can go to zero in 20 minutes from one missing health check; TVL and audit count are not exploit immunity. A same-size event marks the book -40% instantly — through HARD_KILL (-10%) in one block.
spa_relevance.pendle_pt_20pct: Analog via Balancer bb-e-USD: wrapped/boosted exposure to an exploited venue (pool held eTokens) lost >65% of pool TVL and was frozen in recovery mode. PT tokens on a compromised underlying behave the same: the derivative wrapper adds a recovery-coordination layer and delay, it does not insulate principal.
spa_relevance.maple_15pct: Freeze precedent more than exploit precedent: withdrawals halted protocol-wide for ~30 days including unaffected depositors. Any sleeve with gated/permissioned redemption should be stress-modeled with a 30-day liquidity blackout.
spa_relevance.morpho_steakhouse_15pct: Curated-vault contagion channel: Idle and Angle were exactly this — third-party vaults/integrators routing user funds into the exploited market. Idle's outcome (paused immediately, recovered 100% via coordinated redemption + basket swap-back) is the good path; it still required ~1 month and active curator work. Curator responsiveness is a real risk parameter.
spa_relevance.cash_10pct: The only sleeve that stays actionable during a freeze. Kill-switch mechanics (SOFT -5% / HARD -10%) cannot execute against frozen positions — during Mar 13-Apr 12 there was literally no sell button. Cash is the only lever the ladder can actually pull mid-freeze.
spa_relevance.accounting_question: Mark-to-zero vs mark-to-recovery, on the $100k book with a 40% sleeve in the exploited protocol: Mar 13 mark-to-zero => NAV $60k (-40%, instant HARD_KILL breach, unactionable because frozen). Apr 4 (all recoverable funds back) / Apr 12 (claims open) mark-to-recovery => ~100% of exploit-time USD value restored, i.e. realized loss ~0% — recovered basket was even worth ~$223M vs $197M exploited because ETH appreciated. Caveats for a USDC book: (1) redemption paid a pro-rata ETH/DAI/USDC basket, so a USDC depositor carried ~1 month of ETH price risk plus swap costs on the way back to USDC — the ETH appreciation was luck, not design; (2) mark-to-recovery was unknowable ex ante: full attacker return is the exception (base rate for full voluntary return of a $100M+ exploit is low); a policy of instantly realizing -40% (selling claims at the ~10-30 cents-on-the-dollar distressed quotes typical mid-crisis) would have destroyed capital that patient holders recovered in full. Suggested stress encoding: instant -40% NAV shock, 30-day freeze on the affected sleeve, then a bimodal recovery distribution (full recovery vs low-double-digit residual) resolving over 22-30 days.
spa_relevance.policy_note: For SPA's ladder this event argues that drawdown from a frozen/exploited position should be flagged as 'evidenced but unactionable' rather than triggering forced liquidation of the REMAINING liquid sleeves at the bottom tick.

assumptions: КОНТРФАКТ, названный явно: книга Euler не держала; для теста учёта mark-to-zero/mark-to-recovery 15%-рукав morpho_steakhouse маппится на Euler-подобную позицию (символ EULER_CLAIM): halt 30 дней, справедливая стоимость требования 0.10-0.15 три недели (вторичная паника), возврат к пару к дню 30 (историч. факт: вернули ~100%).

Урок направления: HARD_KILL сработает на −13.5% NAV, но исполнить выход НЕЛЬЗЯ (halt) — а «неисполнимость» здесь СПАСЛА от фиксации −85%. Обобщать нельзя: в Terra/FTX то же терпение теряло всё — асимметрия невыводимая, и это главный вывод сценария.
